title: SEC1: DKIM seed zeroization pattern divergence
description:
Maintainer Burden + Security Hygiene

CRITICAL: Two code paths zero the Ed25519 seed differently:
  • main.rs:205 zeroizes a named variable after Ed25519Key construction
  • config.rs:583 zeroizes and discards bytes without extracting a key

Additionally, config.rs never validates that seed + pubkey can construct a working Ed25519Key. A seed could pass validation but fail at startup.

Risk: Solo maintainer updating one path incorrectly; subtle divergence in security-critical code.

Recommendation: Centralize seed validation in config.rs to prove seed + pubkey pair is valid during startup, not just at runtime.
